title: USJP Designathon
description: A product-design-first hackathon: teams pitch, prototype and usability-test a digital product in 48 hours before writing a line of production code. Judged on research depth and interaction design, not just polish.
location: Faculty of Applied Sciences, University of Sri Jayewardenepura
whoCanParticipate: Open to undergraduates from any discipline - design, business or engineering. Teams of 2-4.
